sources.entry: Boxer - The DOS game emulator that’s fit for your Mac.

summary.one_liner: Boxer is a DOS game emulator for macOS, built on DOSBox, with an Xcode project that also produces a standalone game-app bundler.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a build guide rather than a usage guide. It describes three Xcode targets: "Boxer" (the main emulator app), "Boxer Standalone" (a stripped-down build that wraps a single gamebox into one app and has no game importing or settings UI), and "Boxer Bundler" (a graphical tool that turns gameboxes into standalone apps using its own copy of Boxer Standalone). It states that the project is meant to be a one-click build with all frameworks and dependencies included in the repo. The Boxer target has Release and Debug configurations, both producing optimized 32-bit binaries; Debug adds console messages and extra OpenGL error checking. The README also gives OS X version support: Boxer and Boxer Standalone run on OS X 10.6+, and Bundler on 10.8+. PowerPC and 10.5 support were removed from master and remain only in a "leopard_legacy" branch.
use_cases: run DOS games on a Mac
build the Boxer emulator from source
package a DOS game into a standalone Mac app
study or modify a DOSBox-based macOS emulator
maintain legacy Mac OS X 10.5 or PowerPC builds
how_to_run: Install Xcode 4.5 or higher on OS X 10.8 or higher
Select the 'Boxer' target and build (Release or Debug configuration)
To build the bundler, select the 'Boxer Bundler' target
For legacy OS X 10.5 or PowerPC support, use the 'leopard_legacy' branch
notable: Ships a Boxer Bundler GUI tool that converts gameboxes into standalone Mac apps
Builds from one Xcode project with all frameworks bundled in the repo
Only 32-bit builds, because DOSBox is not fully 64-bit compatible
Supports OS X 10.6 and above for the emulator itself
Separate leopard_legacy branch for OS X 10.5 and PowerPC
caveats: Builds only as 32-bit; does not compile for 64-bit because DOSBox is not fully 64-bit compatible
Requires OS X 10.8+ and Xcode 4.5+ to build; the Bundler needs 10.8+
OS X 10.5 and PowerPC support were removed from master
